source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

offlane.quote: Stand behind your minions and poke with Dread Nova, then drop Ether Crystal on anyone who dives you to push them away and slow them. Once Inquisition and Timewarp are done, follow a Dread Nova stun with Synaptic Obliterator beams on the lowest-health target.
offlane.issue: Ether Crystal implodes after 2s and pulls enemies back to its center, so it does not keep divers pushed away
offlane.rewrite: Stand behind your minions and poke with Dread Nova, then drop Ether Crystal on anyone who dives you to slow them and pull them into its center. Once Inquisition and Timewarp are done, follow a Dread Nova stun with Synaptic Obliterator beams on the lowest-health target.

offlane.quote: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades where they walk, then lob Land Mine to stun and knock them back and land R2000 Missile while they're slowed. Once Combustion and Orion are done, step forward and use Make It Rain when they're stuck in your mines.
offlane.issue: 'stuck in your mines' overstates: Cluster Grenades only slow, nothing roots
offlane.rewrite: Lay H11 Cluster Grenades where they walk, then lob Land Mine to stun and knock them back and land R2000 Missile while they're slowed. Once Combustion and Orion are done, step forward and use Make It Rain while your grenades slow them.

carry.quote: Murdock wins this lane at range, so stay behind minions and only commit when Seismic Assault can land the stun.
carry.issue: 'at range' is an unsupported reason; the source only gives the matchup verdict
carry.rewrite: Murdock wins this lane on our sim, so stay behind minions and only commit when Seismic Assault can land the stun.

offlane.quote: Carry Boulder Throw in, Pounce while holding it so the stun shatters on landing, then Rumble to slow them. Once Inquisition and Mutilator are built, use Behemoth in fights near several enemies to heal more while you keep swinging.
offlane.issue: garbled: the boulder shatters on landing, not 'the stun'
offlane.rewrite: Carry Boulder Throw in, Pounce while holding it so the boulder shatters on landing and stuns them, then Rumble to slow them. Once Inquisition and Mutilator are built, use Behemoth in fights near several enemies to heal more while you keep swinging.

support.quote: Throw Highland Hurl first to slow them and cut their armor, then Wild Rush in and spin Ruthless Assault, saving the Empowered ability for a Highland Hurl root. Once Stonewall and Forticus are built, stand in front and absorb hits for your carry.
support.issue: 'the Empowered ability' is unexplained jargon for a new player
support.rewrite: Throw Highland Hurl first to slow them and cut their armor, then Wild Rush in and spin Ruthless Assault; at full Hersir stacks your next Highland Hurl roots. Once Stonewall and Forticus are built, stand in front and absorb hits for your carry.
